career_ladder.note: Female Health Worker (Swasthya Karyakartri / Auxiliary Nurse Midwife - ANM) is the frontline healthcare provider in primary healthcare sub-centres and village health wellness centres across Uttar Pradesh under the Directorate of Family Welfare, Department of Medical, Health and Family Welfare. They deliver maternal and child health services, universal immunization, antenatal care, and family planning programs.

exam_scheme.note: Female candidates possessing ANM diploma credentials registered with the Uttar Pradesh Nurses and Midwives Council are shortlisted through their UPSSSC PET normalized scores. The recruitment features a single-stage Main Written Examination of 100 marks covering core nursing, midwifery, and community healthcare curricula. Negative marking is 0.25 (1/4th) per wrong answer.

financial_package.note: Female Health Worker (ANM) is placed in Pay Level 3 (Pay Band ₹5,200–₹20,200 with Grade Pay ₹2,000) under the Uttar Pradesh Revised Pay Rules, 2016. In addition, ANMs receive uniform maintenance allowance and rural healthcare sub-centre allowances.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Directorate of Family Welfare UP & UP Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 3
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 3 entry basic pay of ₹21,700 at 58% DA (effective 01.07.2025), HRA (₹1,800 to ₹3,600 depending on rural/urban sub-centre location), uniform washing allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹3,429) and group insurance deductions.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised semi-annually per UP Finance Department orders
House Rent Allowance (HRA) or government staff quarters at primary health centre
Annual uniform allowance and washing allowance
Mobility and travel allowance for pulse polio and village immunization rounds
Medical reimbursement under UP Government Servants Medical Attendance Rules
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% matching employer contribution
